 By Tom Kao November 6, 2026 From a lovable nine-tailed fox to a small-town dentist and a determined politician, Shin Min-a has played quite a variety of characters over the years. Now, with the actress taking on the role of an empress in Disney+'s "The Remarried Empress," there's no better time to revisit some of her most memorable performances. If you're already hooked on the royal romance and looking for more of Shin Min-a while waiting for new episodes, here are nine of her K-dramas worth adding to your watchlist, from heartwarming romances to gripping thrillers 
 Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha (2021)
 If you're in the mood for a feel-good romance, Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha is a great place to start. Shin Min-a plays Yoon Hye-jin, a successful dentist who leaves Seoul after a career setback and opens a clinic in the seaside village of Gongjin. There, she meets Hong Du-sik (Kim Seon-ho), a charming jack-of-all-trades who's always lending the locals a hand. Although Hye-jin initially struggles to adjust to small-town life, her constant bickering with Du-sik gradually turns into something sweeter, bringing plenty of laughs and heartwarming moments along the way.
 My Girlfriend Is a Gumiho (2010)
 Photo: SBS
 One of Shin Min-a's most iconic roles, My Girlfriend Is a Gumiho follows Cha Dae-woong (Lee Seung-gi), an aspiring action star who accidentally frees a legendary nine-tailed fox trapped inside a painting for centuries. Played by Shin, the mysterious creature takes human form as Mi-ho and saves his life using her magical fox bead. Although initially terrified of her, Dae-woong agrees to help Mi-ho become human through a 100-day arrangement. But as they grow closer, their unusual relationship takes a romantic turn, bringing some unexpected complications along the way.
 No Gain No Love (2024)
 Would you get married just to secure a promotion? That's exactly what Shin Min-a's character has in mind in No Gain No Love . She plays Son Hae-young, a practical woman who hates losing out on anything, especially money. When she realises being single could cost her a promotion, she convinces convenience store worker Kim Ji-wook (Kim Young-dae) to become her fake husband. Things get even more complicated when Ji-wook unexpectedly joins her company, forcing them to keep up appearances while their pretend relationship gradually turns into something real.

 Oh My Venus (2015)
 Looking for a classic K-drama rom-com? Oh My Venus pairs Shin Min-a with So Ji-sub in a heartwarming story about love and rediscovering confidence. Shin plays Kang Joo-eun, a lawyer who was once known for her beauty but has since struggled with her weight and self-esteem. After her boyfriend of 15 years breaks up with her, she meets Kim Young-ho (So Ji-sub), a celebrity personal trainer hiding his identity. Determined to turn her life around, she enlists his help, and before long, their trainer-client relationship blossoms into an unexpected romance.
 Our Blues (2022)
 Set against the beautiful backdrop of Jeju Island, Our Blues follows the interconnected lives of ordinary people navigating love, family and personal struggles. Shin Min-a takes on a more emotional role as Min Seon-a, a woman battling depression while dealing with a difficult marriage and a custody battle over her young son. When she returns to Jeju, she reconnects with Lee Dong-seok (Lee Byung-hun), a travelling salesman who once had feelings for her. As they confront their complicated pasts, the two slowly begin to find comfort and healing in each other.
 Chief of Staff Season 1-2 (2019)
 Want to see Shin Min-a in a completely different role? Chief of Staff follows Jang Tae-joon (Lee Jung-jae), an ambitious parliamentary aide determined to climb the political ladder. Shin plays Kang Seon-yeong, a former lawyer turned National Assembly member who is secretly dating Tae-joon, despite their opposing political interests. Keeping their relationship under wraps is already tricky enough, but things get even messier as they become caught in corruption scandals, dangerous alliances and political power struggles that threaten not only their careers but also their personal ideals.
 Tomorrow, With You (2017)
 What if you could travel into the future and discover your own fate? In Tomorrow, With You , Lee Je-hoon plays Yoo So-joon, a wealthy businessman who can travel through time using the subway. After witnessing his own death in a future accident, he marries Song Ma-rin (Shin Min-a), a struggling photographer and former child actress, hoping to change their fate. But as their marriage develops, his mysterious disappearances and hidden motives begin to raise questions, especially when their feelings for each other become increasingly genuine.
 Karma (2025)
 Taking a darker turn from her usual romantic roles, Shin Min-a stars in Netflix's crime thriller Karma , alongside Park Hae-soo and Lee Hee-jun. The six-episode series follows a debt-ridden man whose desperate plan to collect his father's life insurance sets off a chain of crimes, betrayals and deadly consequences. Shin plays Lee Ju-yeon, a doctor haunted by a traumatic experience from her past. When someone connected to that trauma unexpectedly reappears, she finds herself caught in a dangerous web linking six seemingly unrelated individuals.
 Arang and the Magistrate (2012)
 Photo: MBC
 For another dose of fantasy romance, Arang and the Magistrate takes viewers back to the Joseon era with a supernatural twist. Shin Min-a plays Arang, a spirited ghost determined to uncover the truth behind her mysterious death. She teams up with Kim Eun-oh (Lee Joon-gi), a government official who can see ghosts and is searching for his missing mother. When Eun-oh notices Arang wearing a hairpin connected to his mother, their investigation takes an unexpected turn, uncovering dark secrets while an unlikely romance begins to blossom.
